source_facts: Its OnRemoteRequest switches GET_PROTO_INFO to ProcessProto (dbinder_callback_stub.cpp:160-168).
ProcessProto checks caller UID/PID, current skeleton, service-manager object and sessionName, then calls ProcessData (dbinder_callback_stub.cpp:94-118).
ProcessData serializes PID, UID, local device ID, stub index and token ID, then sends DBINDER_ADD_COMMAUTH (dbinder_callback_stub.cpp:121-143).

IPCObjectStub::SendRequest routes GET_PROTO_INFO through virtual ProcessProto; ProcessProto is virtual and overridden, so base dispatch may enter the same implementation without OnRemoteRequest (ipc_object_stub.cpp:439-475; ipc_object_stub.h:191).
Receiver DBINDER_ADD_COMMAUTH handler rejects local IPC and caller UID >= ALLOWED_UID before AddAuthInfo (ipc_object_stub.cpp:299-320).
entry_dispatch_path.review_hypothesis: Potential relay into protocol auth-info flow without a descriptor comparison visible in this route; receiver UID gate and protocol/session semantics may constrain it. No cross-interface effect is established.

guards: Negative UID/PID, null skeleton/object, and empty session are rejected (callback_stub.cpp:94-117).
Parcel writes and unavailable databus invoker are rejected (callback_stub.cpp:127-137).
Receiver rejects local calls and UID >= ALLOWED_UID before AddAuthInfo (ipc_object_stub.cpp:299-320).
No explicit descriptor compare is visible in the callback route.
observed_guards_and_controls.authorization_gate: Receiver gate uses databus invoker caller UID; source alone does not establish UID provenance, policy completeness, or product configuration.

Product reachability, object registration, and external caller control.
Stable and occurrence identity are both unknown.
